column1: # bench/history.tsv: one record per `bench run` (tools/bench.forge), newest last. `bench check` compares the
# note=orphan (e42065b, 836c322, 207d8e7): the sha is not a commit in this repository; those runs were taken on
# commits that were rewritten before landing (the sha names the work tree, not a landed commit). Kept for the
# timings; never use them as a baseline. Since the integrity change, `bench run` records the full sha and refuses
# a dirty tree (or marks it "+dirty" with --allow-dirty).
